$note: Three MCP servers under Shape C: `attest` (stdio, published as @bpmforge/attest-mcp) hosts the Shape-C policy engine + in-process expert handlers + 77 validators + phase_gate_check + route_goal + list_experts; `attest-conductor` is the hosted BDK chief for /autopilot and GitHub-driven work; `attest-policy-dev` is a second attest-mcp instance pinned to ATTEST_POLICY_MODE=LOG_ONLY so the editor-side chief can author policies without blocking the user. See .cursor/README.md "Shape-C policy mode flip" for how to flip to ENFORCE.

attest.$comment: Primary attest-mcp server. Under Shape C this is both the validator surface (unchanged) and the policy host (new in Shape C: evaluate_shell_policy, evaluate_write_policy, evaluate_mcp_policy, list_fences, request_approval, invoke_expert, pre_dispatch_check). Default mode is the attest-mcp server's own default (ENFORCE once the policy bundle lands); override per-user by setting ATTEST_POLICY_MODE in the user's shell env.

attest-conductor.$comment: Local-dev invocation: served out of packages/attest-conductor via @cursor/bdk serve --mode single. For deployed Cursor installs, replace this stanza with { "url": "https://<your-conductor-host>/v1/mcp", "type": "http" } pointing at the deployed BDK agent (BDK deployments expose /<slug>/v1/mcp automatically). Private package: cannot be reached via `npx -y @bpmforge/attest-conductor`.

attest-policy-dev.$comment: Shape-C local-dev policy engine. Same binary as `attest`, pinned to ATTEST_POLICY_MODE=LOG_ONLY so the editor-side chief (sdlc-lead) can test policies without blocking the user. Decisions get written through to `docs/work/policy-decisions.jsonl` by the policy hooks. Flip to ENFORCE (either here or in the `attest` entry) when the policy bundle is trusted; see .cursor/README.md.
